plugins.name: stark
plugins.description: Anti-slop multi-platform UI generator. Asks the user which track first (system-like native, branded native, Tauri 2, Electron, RN, Flutter), then ships distinctive design — not template clones. Web (React/Tailwind v4 + Motion), Windows (WinUI 3 + Mica), Apple (SwiftUI 7 + Liquid Glass), Android (Compose + M3 Expressive). Per-platform anti-slop ban lists.
